notes: Large-source unit עַד־לְמַעְלָה → was exceeding great retained: the four morphemes share the one rendering exceeding great with the construction copula (rules 30, 49); no English word answers to any one morpheme in particular, so it is indivisible, headed on מַעְלָה/exceeding with great as the competing target head. וְגַם rendered by the single yet: the waw takes it and גַּם is unrepresented (rule 14).
